hypothesis: A previously observed suspension followed by restored official spot access may permit delayed participation demand. This is an unvalidated hypothesis, not evidence of positive return.
eligibility: Known non-TRADING to TRADING, spot allowed, USDT quote; first snapshot is baseline, never an event.
invalidation: Official non-TRADING/spot forbidden/removal, 5% price loss, or seven days after initial fill.
failure_rule: Never infer zero inventory on gaps. Freeze ENTER/ADD; retain OPEN quantities; send RISK. Exit intent persists without a fresh book; no invented fill. Model unavailable does not block deterministic risk or BASIC_EVENT.
threshold_basis: All sizes, seven-day horizon and numeric gates are conservative engineering assumptions frozen before local tests. No market outcome was used to tune them.

mini.semantics: changed symbols only; v/q rolling 24h; missing symbols are not delisted

metadata.trust: Official exchange state; omit unused permissionSets payload, retain statuses/spot/filters and all symbols; revision retained with previous receipt

bar.semantics: closed bars only, actual quote volume, dedup by symbol/open time; conflicting revision quarantined

slow_economic.reason: Additional adapters deferred; no claim of eight active sources

proposed_new_trial_limits.authorization: Separate observer trial approval required; never resets or borrows existing Alpha authority

retention: No automatic deletion. Evidence pins extend beyond latest horizon, thesis closure, position closure and audit completion. OPEN or unaudited means indefinite pin.

clock_model.assumptions: Engineering bounds, not a fitted offset. Full RTT includes asymmetry; stale/new-session/unbounded clocks freeze buys. No retrospective calibration.

data_contract.clock_request_budget_note: New calibration requests share the unchanged 688 active HTTP attempt cap; no existing quota increase. Long-run budget approval required.

clock_pending.retention: Only active queue is bounded. Terminal outcomes and original evidence remain append-only.
